description: Hey, welcome to Verdanta! 🌱 For now, you can connect with us through the NASA Space Apps platform. Once our team is complete, we'll create a WhatsApp group to discuss ideas, share research, divide tasks and keep everyone updated. We want everyone to feel comfortable sharing their thoughts, suggestions or doubts. Good communication and teamwork will be our priority, so feel free to reach out anytime. Let's stay connected and make this project something we're all proud of!
